changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[Execution]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [Total] [int] NOT NULL, [Processed] [int] NOT NULL, [Error] [int] NOT NULL, [StartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [Fields] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [ErrorMessage] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Method] [varchar](7) NULL, [Route] [varchar](250) NULL, [ProcessingStartedOn] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecution] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'State' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] ADD [State] int NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_State] DEFAULT ((1)) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'QueuedForProcessing' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] ADD [QueuedForProcessing] bit NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_QueuedForProcessing] DEFAULT ((0)) END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'State' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_State] ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] DROP COLUMN [State] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'QueuedForProcessing' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_QueuedForProcessing] ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] DROP COLUMN [QueuedForProcessing] END
